verdict.rationale: Evidence shows no documented public API for Llama: OpenAPI/swagger probes all 404, llms.txt 404, and the developer docs pages are gated behind an SSO login wall rather than being openly documented. The CLI tooling (llama-models) only covers downloading/verifying model weights, not driving an API; actual inference is offered only via third-party hosts (AWS, Azure, HF), not a first-party documented public API.
